title_en: 2026 Undergraduate Research Internship Program: Applications (Aerospace Engineering)
summary: Interested Aerospace Engineering undergraduates in years 2 to 4 who meet all eligibility requirements may apply for the 2026 Undergraduate Research Internship, which runs from 15 December 2026 to 8 February 2027 and pays 800,000 KRW per student. Applicants must submit Form 1 [서식1], confirmed by their laboratory supervisor, to the department by email by Wednesday 4 November 2026. Selected students will be announced on 20 November 2026 and must complete the safety and environment training and submit the certificate by the end of November 2026.
applies_to: Optional. Open to enrolled 2nd- to 4th-year students of College of Engineering departments (this notice covers the Department of Aerospace Engineering, which has 3 places) who meet all of the following: can participate at least 10 hours per week; can complete the Fall 2026 regular safety and environment training; and will have no change in academic status during Fall 2026 and the internship period. Students who have already received scholarships, grants or similar support are discouraged from being recommended.

translation:
2026 Undergraduate Research Internship Program: Application Information (Department of Aerospace Engineering)

We announce the details of support under the 2026 Undergraduate Research Internship Program as follows. Interested students are invited to apply.

A. Places allocated to the department (※ allocated considering the number of full-time faculty and the number of students registered in the previous semester)

Department: Aerospace Engineering | Places: 3 | Stipend: 800,000 KRW per undergraduate (400,000 KRW x 2 months) | Total department support: 2,400,000 KRW

B. Support details
1) Internship period: Tuesday 15 December 2026 to Monday 8 February 2027, 8 weeks in total.
2) Eligibility: enrolled 2nd- to 4th-year students of College of Engineering departments who meet all of the following:
- able to participate for at least 10 hours per week;
- able to complete the Fall 2026 regular safety and environment training;
- enrolled students with no change in academic status during Fall 2026 and the internship period.
※ Recommendation of students who have already received scholarships, grants, etc. is discouraged.
3) Internship stipend: 800,000 KRW per undergraduate (400,000 KRW x 2 months).

C. Application method and procedure
1) Method: submit documents by email (address given in the original notice) by Wednesday 4 November.
2) Documents: [Form 1] Undergraduate Research Internship Application and Recommendation; [Attachment 3] Applicant List.
- Undergraduates submit [Form 1], confirmed by their laboratory supervisor, to their department.
- The department selects confirmed and reserve candidates according to its allocated places, prepares the [Attachment 3] applicant list, and submits it with [Form 1] to the College of Engineering.
※ The applicant list is prepared in order of priority. For other details, read [Attachment 1] Support Plan before applying.

D. Management of the internship
- Undergraduates write and submit a [Form 2] result report describing tasks performed, expected outcomes, etc. (once a month).
- Laboratory staff continuously manage the students' research activity through the [Form 3] attendance log.
- Department staff submit documents for stipend payment (once a month).

E. Schedule
- Department announcement and website posting: early October 2026
- Receipt of applications: handled individually by each department
- Submission of department applicant list (department to College of Engineering): by Friday 6 November 2026
- Confirmation and announcement of selected students (College of Engineering to departments): Friday 20 November 2026
- Selected students complete the safety and environment training and submit the certificate: by the end of November 2026
- Internship: Tuesday 15 December 2026 to Monday 8 February 2027
- Submission of stipend payment documents: (1st round) by Friday 15 January 2027; (2nd round) by Wednesday 10 February 2027
- Completion of budget spending and submission of settlement (College of Engineering to Research Affairs Office): by Friday 12 February 2027

Attachments:
1. 2026 College of Engineering Undergraduate Research Internship Support Plan
2. 2026 College of Engineering Undergraduate Research Internship Application Guide (for undergraduates)
3. 2026 College of Engineering Undergraduate Research Internship Applicant List (Aerospace Engineering)
4. Undergraduate Research Internship Stipend Payment Application List (department name, round)
5. Safety and environment training forms and regulations
